title: StarTrail-org/PixelRAG
claim: StarTrail-org/PixelRAG — The end of web parsing. The beginning of scalable pixel-native search. link: https://pixelrag.ai/

value: Businesses in sectors like e-commerce and digital marketing could pay for advanced search capabilities that enhance user experience and improve conversion rates.
